sources.snippet: EfficientFormer: Imagenet classifier and general purpose backbone EfficientFormer is a vision transformer model that can classify images from the Imagenet dataset. This is based on the implementation of EfficientFormer found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices.
